data.installScript:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
INSTALL_PATH=${INSTALL_PATH:-/var/lib/docker}
PORTS=${PORTS:-2375:2375,2376:2376}
echo "[Docker] 开始安装 Docker Engine..."
echo "[Docker] 安装路径: $INSTALL_PATH"
echo "[Docker] 端口映射: $PORTS"

# 卸载旧版本
if command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "[Docker] 检测到已安装 Docker，跳过安装流程"
  exit 0
fi

# 安装依赖
if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "[Docker] 使用 apt 包管理器"
  sudo apt-get update -qq
  sudo apt-get install -y -qq ca-certificates curl
  sudo install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings
  sudo curl -fsSL https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu/gpg -o /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc
  sudo chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc
  echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc] https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu $(. /etc/os-release && echo "$VERSION_CODENAME") stable" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list > /dev/null
  sudo apt-get update -qq
  sudo apt-get install -y -qq docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin
elif command -v yum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "[Docker] 使用 yum 包管理器"
  sudo yum install -y -q yum-utils
  sudo yum-config-manager --add-repo https://download.docker.com/linux/centos/docker-ce.repo
  sudo yum install -y -q docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin
elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "[Docker] 使用 dnf 包管理器"
  sudo dnf -q install -y dnf-plugins-core
  sudo dnf config-manager --add-repo https://download.docker.com/linux/centos/docker-ce.repo
  sudo dnf -q install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin
else
  echo "[Docker] 不支持的包管理器，尝试使用官方脚本"
  curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com | sh
fi

# 配置 Docker 数据目录
if [ "$INSTALL_PATH" != "/var/lib/docker" ]; then
  sudo mkdir -p "$INSTALL_PATH"
  sudo tee /etc/docker/daemon.json >/dev/null <<DAEMON_EOF
{
  "data-root": "$INSTALL_PATH",
  "log-driver": "json-file",
  "log-opts": {
    "max-size": "10m",
    "max-file": "3"
  },
  "storage-driver": "overlay2"
}
DAEMON_EOF
fi

# 添加当前用户到 docker 组
sudo usermod -aG docker ${SUDO_USER:-${USER:-root}} || true

# 启动 Docker
sudo systemctl enable docker
sudo systemctl start docker || sudo service docker start

echo "[Docker] 安装完成"
docker --version

data.statusScript:
#!/bin/bash
if command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Docker 版本: $(docker --version 2>/dev/null || echo '未知')"
  echo "Docker Compose: $(docker compose version 2>/dev/null || echo '未安装')"
fi
sudo systemctl status docker --no-pager 2>/dev/null || ps -ef | grep dockerd | grep -v grep || echo "Docker 未运行"
data.uninstallScript:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
echo "[Docker] 开始卸载 Docker Engine..."

# 停止所有运行中的容器
echo "[Docker] 停止运行中的容器..."
sudo docker stop $(sudo docker ps -aq) 2>/dev/null || true
sudo docker rm $(sudo docker ps -aq) 2>/dev/null || true

# 停止 Docker 服务
sudo systemctl stop docker || sudo service docker stop || true

# 根据包管理器卸载
if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo apt-get remove -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin 2>/dev/null || true
  sudo apt-get purge -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io 2>/dev/null || true
elif command -v yum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo yum remove -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin 2>/dev/null || true
elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo dnf remove -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin 2>/dev/null || true
fi

# 清理残留文件
sudo rm -rf /var/lib/docker 2>/dev/null || true
sudo rm -rf /var/lib/containerd 2>/dev/null || true
sudo rm -f /etc/docker/daemon.json 2>/dev/null || true

echo "[Docker] 卸载完成"

data.installScript:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
GUAC_VERSION=${GUAC_VERSION:-1.5.5}
GUAC_HOME=${GUAC_HOME:-/etc/guacamole}
GUAC_USER=${GUAC_USER:-guacadmin}
GUAC_PASSWORD=${GUAC_PASSWORD:-guacadmin}
echo [guacamole] installing
if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo apt-get update
  sudo apt-get install -y tomcat9 guacd wget || sudo apt-get install -y tomcat9 wget
  TOMCAT_SERVICE=tomcat9
  TOMCAT_WEBAPPS=/var/lib/tomcat9/webapps
elif command -v yum >/dev/null 2>&1 || command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  PM=$(command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo dnf || echo yum)
  sudo $PM install -y epel-release || true
  sudo $PM install -y tomcat guacd wget || sudo $PM install -y tomcat wget
  TOMCAT_SERVICE=tomcat
  TOMCAT_WEBAPPS=/var/lib/tomcat/webapps
else
  echo unsupported package manager
  exit 1
fi
sudo mkdir -p "$GUAC_HOME" "$TOMCAT_WEBAPPS"
sudo wget -q -O "$TOMCAT_WEBAPPS/guacamole.war" "https://archive.apache.org/dist/guacamole/$GUAC_VERSION/binary/guacamole-$GUAC_VERSION.war"
sudo tee "$GUAC_HOME/guacamole.properties" >/dev/null <<EOF
guacd-hostname: localhost
guacd-port: 4822
EOF
sudo tee "$GUAC_HOME/user-mapping.xml" >/dev/null <<EOF
<user-mapping>
  <authorize username="$GUAC_USER" password="$GUAC_PASSWORD">
  </authorize>
</user-mapping>
EOF
sudo mkdir -p /usr/share/tomcat9 /var/lib/tomcat9 /usr/share/tomcat /var/lib/tomcat
sudo ln -sfn "$GUAC_HOME" /usr/share/tomcat9/.guacamole || true
sudo ln -sfn "$GUAC_HOME" /var/lib/tomcat9/.guacamole || true
sudo ln -sfn "$GUAC_HOME" /usr/share/tomcat/.guacamole || true
sudo ln -sfn "$GUAC_HOME" /var/lib/tomcat/.guacamole || true
sudo systemctl enable guacd || true
sudo systemctl enable "$TOMCAT_SERVICE" || true
sudo systemctl restart guacd || sudo service guacd restart || true
sudo systemctl restart "$TOMCAT_SERVICE" || sudo service "$TOMCAT_SERVICE" restart
echo [guacamole] install finished
data.startScript:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
sudo systemctl start guacd || sudo service guacd start || true
sudo systemctl start tomcat9 || sudo systemctl start tomcat || sudo service tomcat9 start || sudo service tomcat start
data.stopScript:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
sudo systemctl stop tomcat9 || sudo systemctl stop tomcat || sudo service tomcat9 stop || sudo service tomcat stop
sudo systemctl stop guacd || sudo service guacd stop || true
data.restartScript:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
sudo systemctl restart guacd || sudo service guacd restart || true
sudo systemctl restart tomcat9 || sudo systemctl restart tomcat || sudo service tomcat9 restart || sudo service tomcat restart
data.statusScript:
#!/bin/bash
(sudo systemctl is-active guacd || true) && (sudo systemctl is-active tomcat9 || sudo systemctl is-active tomcat || ps -ef | grep '[t]omcat')
data.uninstallScript:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
sudo systemctl stop tomcat9 || sudo systemctl stop tomcat || true
sudo systemctl stop guacd || true
sudo rm -f /var/lib/tomcat9/webapps/guacamole.war /var/lib/tomcat/webapps/guacamole.war
echo [guacamole] webapp removed, config kept: /etc/guacamole
data.presetRemark: Linux Guacamole 预设
